gpio_pin.description: BCM pin driving the servo signal (informational; the PWM overlay in config.txt fixes the actual pin).

pwm_channel.description: PWM channel within the controller (channel 0 for GPIO 12 under the single-channel overlay).

min_pulse_us.description: Pulse width in microseconds at full-left travel.

max_pulse_us.description: Pulse width in microseconds at full-right travel.

range_deg.description: Total mechanical travel in degrees spanned between min_pulse_us and max_pulse_us.

center_pulse_us.description: Pulse width in microseconds that holds the wheels straight.

reversed.description: Invert steering direction when the servo is mounted so left commands turn right.

pwm_frequency_hz.description: Servo PWM carrier frequency in Hz; the servo's 20 ms frame period derives from it.
